## What's changed

- Added four selectable AI upscaling models: FSRCNNX Fast, FSRCNNX Quality, ArtCNN Balanced, and ArtCNN Quality.
- Redesigned the Upscaling settings with clear model guidance, expected GPU load, recommended content types, and visible fallback paths.
- Added per-model compatibility checks and progressive fallback to lighter AI models or Standard upscaling so unsupported models do not interrupt playback.
- Added the resolved AI model to live playback information, making it clear which upscaler is actually running.
- Bundled every AI model in the Docker and macOS packages with pinned checksum verification.
- Fixed the macOS packaging validation step and expanded it to test every bundled AI model through FFmpeg and MoltenVK before publishing the app.

These are server-side updates; Tater Tube players do not need to be updated.
